description: Auto hard-refresh on login when a new deployment is published. On login success, baseline the server app-version (localStorage oms_app_version) and the Vite build constant (localStorage oms_build). A ~60s periodic check compares the running build constant and the server /api/app-version against the stored baselines and hard-reloads once when either differs, always writing the new value to localStorage BEFORE reloading (loop-guarded). Add a Vite build-time constant __APP_BUILD__ and add /api/app-version + /api/force-refresh to the local/Render backend (absent today). Independent of FEAT-001. See plan.md TASK 2 for exact edits.
steps: vite.config.js: add a `define: { __APP_BUILD__: JSON.stringify(Date.now().toString()) }` block to the existing defineConfig, keeping plugins (react()), base '/', and server.proxy to localhost:5000.

src/context/AuthContext.jsx: lift the hardReload() helper (currently defined inside the daily-13:40 useEffect, ~line 51) to component scope inside AuthProvider so it is reusable; update the daily-refresh effect to call the shared helper. Keep the existing daily-13:40 refresh behavior intact.

src/context/AuthContext.jsx login() (~line 85): after a successful login, in a try/catch, GET /api/app-version and store the returned version in localStorage['oms_app_version'] as the baseline, and store the running bundle build via localStorage.setItem('oms_build', __APP_BUILD__). A failed version fetch must not block login.

src/context/AuthContext.jsx: add a ~60s setInterval (in an effect that runs while logged in; clear on cleanup). Each tick: (a) build check first — read localStorage['oms_build']; if it exists and !== __APP_BUILD__, write __APP_BUILD__ to oms_build FIRST then call hardReload() and return; (b) server-version check — GET /api/app-version in try/catch; read localStorage['oms_app_version']; only if the baseline EXISTS and the server version differs, write the server version to oms_app_version FIRST then hardReload(); if no baseline exists yet, just store it without reloading.

server backend parity: read server/index.js to see how routes mount, then add GET /api/app-version (reads app_settings key app_version, returns { version }, fail-soft to { version: '1' } on error — mirror api/index.js ~185) and POST /api/force-refresh (admin-guarded, sets app_version to Date.now().toString() — mirror api/index.js ~186) in the appropriate server route file so the path resolves as /api/app-version.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` (vite build) from the project root compiles with zero errors, including the new __APP_BUILD__ define and its references in AuthContext.jsx.

AuthContext.jsx: hardReload is shared (not trapped inside the daily effect); login() baselines both oms_app_version and oms_build; a ~60s periodic check performs the build-constant check and the server-version check, each writing the new value to localStorage BEFORE calling hardReload(), and only reloading when the stored baseline exists and differs (no infinite reload loop).
The local/Render backend exposes GET /api/app-version and POST /api/force-refresh resolving at those paths; node --check passes on the edited server file(s).
The existing daily-13:40 refresh still works via the shared hardReload.
verification: Run `npm run build` from d:\OMS PRESTAIR SYSTEMS LLP\oms-dashboard and confirm zero errors (note: __APP_BUILD__ must be defined in vite.config.js before AuthContext references it, or the build fails).
Run `node --check` on any edited server file(s).
Review the AuthContext logic to confirm localStorage is written before every hardReload() and reload only fires on an existing-and-different stored value. Do NOT start the dev server.
findings: Implemented all FEAT-002 steps. vite.config.js: added define { __APP_BUILD__: JSON.stringify(Date.now().toString()) } above server.proxy, keeping plugins/base/proxy intact. AuthContext.jsx: lifted hardReload() to AuthProvider component scope (now shared); daily-13:40 effect uses the shared helper and is otherwise unchanged. login() now baselines localStorage.oms_app_version (from GET /api/app-version, try/catch, non-blocking) and localStorage.oms_build (= __APP_BUILD__). Added a second useEffect keyed on `user` (only runs while logged in, interval cleared on cleanup) with a ~60s setInterval: (a) build check first — if oms_build exists and !== __APP_BUILD__, write __APP_BUILD__ to oms_build THEN hardReload() and return; (b) server-version check — GET /api/app-version in try/catch, if oms_app_version baseline exists and differs, write server version THEN hardReload(), and if no baseline exists just store it without reloading. Every reload writes the new value to localStorage before hardReload(), so no infinite loop. Backend parity: server/index.js mounts orderRoutes at /api/orders, so the two version routes could NOT live in server/routes/orders.js (would resolve at /api/orders/app-version). Added GET /api/app-version (public, fail-soft { version: '1' }) and POST /api/force-refresh (_auth + _admin, sets app_settings.app_version = Date.now()) directly on the Express app in server/index.js, reusing the already-imported _sb/_auth/_admin bindings and matching the adjacent sales-reps route style, so the paths resolve exactly at /api/app-version and /api/force-refresh. The local server backend has no in-memory version cache so none was added. Verification: `npm run build` compiled with zero errors (CJS-deprecation and chunk-size messages are pre-existing warnings, not errors); `node --check server/index.js` passes. Dev server not started. No divergence from the plan requiring a warning. Note: GET /api/app-version depends on an app_settings table in Supabase; absent that table it fails soft to version '1', which safely means no auto-reload is triggered.
